title: 第2章 放火和暗算
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林珝缓过神，透过那扇窄小的窗户，再次看向寨子里的布局。

这几天他装傻充愣，却不是真的混日子。

守卫换班的规律、寨子的地形，包括每个人的活动路线——所有能观察到的东西，都被他都偷偷记在了心里。

黑风寨建在半山腰，三面陡坡，唯一的出口是正门那条盘山土路。

但寨门有两道哨卡，再加一座瞭望塔，正门硬闯就是送死。

好在他知道后山有一条排水渠，是雨季用来泄洪的，旱季根本没人清理，底下堆满了枯枝烂叶。

如果能摸到那里，就有机会。

“可从柴房到排水渠，直线距离少说三百米，守卫们又不是瞎子，除非……我能先制造一场混乱。”

林珝默默计划好了路线，随后把头抬起来，盯着头顶那根松木房梁看了很久。

就它了！

夜里，林珝搞来一只破陶碗，一块从墙角捡来的平整石片当盖子，一根削尖的木楔，还有从房梁上刮下的碎松木块。

他把木块铺在碗底，盖上石片，用泥巴封住边缘的缝隙，调整蜡烛的方位，让火焰刚好能舔到碗底。

松木含有不少油脂，在隔绝空气的条件下加热，可以干馏出松木油。

这东西烧起来火势猛、温度高，还不容易扑灭。

工艺不难，难的是怎么避开门外的守卫。

白天他继续当个傻子，吃饱了就睡，直到后半夜才偷偷爬起来，利用现代人的技术进行提炼。

反复折腾了四个晚上，总算收集到浅浅一层淡黄色的油状液体，大约两汤匙。

量不多，但用来制造一场小型的火灾，已经足够了。

林珝一刻都不想多等，到了第五天凌晨，他第一时间爬起来，趴在窗户上观望。

夜幕下的山寨一片死寂。

确认守卫已经熟睡之后，他才蹑手蹑脚地关上窗，来到屋后一堆干柴处蹲下，先洒下少许木屑，再把提炼的松木油刮了薄薄一层，均匀涂在柴堆表面。

火光靠近松油的那一刻，林珝迟疑了一瞬。

想到“越狱”失败的后果，他心跳得就像打鼓。

“不管了，开弓没有回头箭，这是唯一的机会。”

少许沉默后，他硬着头皮将烛火凑了上去。

经过炼制出的松油燃点极低，柴堆被烤得滋滋作响，火势猛增，很快就蹿起了浓烟。

林珝第一时间退到墙脚，依旧被呛得眼泪直流。

他抓起煤灰，先是在脸上胡乱抹了几把，然后趴在地上大喊救命，

“着火了，咳咳……来人妈！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Jue calmed down and looked at the layout of the village through the narrow window again.

He has been pretending to be stupid these days, but he is not really fooling around.

The regularity of guard shifts, the topography of the stockade, including everyone's movement routes - everything that could be observed was secretly memorized in his mind.

Heifeng Village is built on the mountainside with steep slopes on three sides. The only exit is the winding dirt road at the main entrance.

But there are two checkpoints at the gate of the village, plus a watchtower. If you break through the main gate, you will die.

Fortunately, he knew that there was a drainage channel in the back mountain, which was used to release floods during the rainy season. No one cleaned it during the dry season, and it was filled with dead branches and leaves.

If you can touch there, you have a chance.

"But the straight-line distance from the woodshed to the drainage canal is at least three hundred meters, and the guards are not blind, unless... I can create a chaos first."

Lin Jue silently planned the route, then raised his head and stared at the pine beam above his head for a long time.

That’s it!

At night, Lin Jue got a broken pottery bowl, a flat stone chip picked up from the corner as a lid, a sharpened wooden wedge, and broken pine wood scraped from the beams.

He spread the wood blocks on the bottom of the bowl, covered it with stone chips, sealed the gaps around the edges with mud, and adjusted the position of the candle so that the flame could just lick the bottom of the bowl.

Pine wood contains a lot of oil. When heated in an air-isolated condition, pine oil can be distilled.

This thing burns fiercely, with high temperature, and is not easy to extinguish.

The craftsmanship is not difficult, but the difficult part is how to avoid the guards outside the door.

During the day, he continued to be a fool and went to bed after eating. He didn't get up secretly until late at night and used modern technology to refine it.

After struggling for four nights, I finally collected a shallow layer of light yellow oily liquid, about two tablespoons.

The amount is not much, but it is enough to create a small fire.

Lin Jue didn't want to wait any longer. In the early morning of the fifth day, he got up immediately and lay on the window to watch.

There was deathly silence in the cottage under the night.

After confirming that the guard was asleep, he quietly closed the window, went to a pile of dry firewood at the back of the house and squatted down. He first sprinkled some sawdust, then scraped a thin layer of refined pine oil and spread it evenly on the surface of the firewood pile.

The moment the fire came close to the pine oil, Lin Jue hesitated for a moment.

Thinking of the consequences of a failed "prison break", his heart beat like a drum.

"No matter what, there is no turning back. This is the only chance."

After a moment of silence, he bit the bullet and put the candle up.

The refined pine oil had an extremely low ignition point. The firewood pile was roasting sizzlingly, the fire increased rapidly, and soon thick smoke billowed out.

Lin Jue immediately retreated to the foot of the wall, still choked to tears.

He grabbed the soot and smeared a few handfuls on his face. Then he lay on the ground and shouted for help.

"It's on fire, cough...come on, mom!"
